lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet already had verified grading, market, release/event, purchase and neural screen-priority systems, but the reviewed mobile TCG video showed faster integrated flows for a market-aware home, live capture guidance, region/map purchase discovery, HOT card/BOX scanning and card-portfolio summary. Those experience modules were not yet predeclared as a bounded user-reversible layer governed by the existing verified autonomy plan.
lessons.prevention_rule: Predeclare exactly five video-reference experience modules on top of the existing verified tablet functions, derive their order only from existing bounded feature priorities and non-directional market/release/event activity, reuse existing camera quality signals and purchase controls, rank HOT items by verified freshness/link/activity rather than price direction, persist only a coarse user-selected region and never precise coordinates, and make the whole experience user-reversible and fail closed when required DOM/runtime bindings drift.
validation_required: protected main squash-merge candidate is exactly 501e9bcb34910376937bec35cfefa0a1dfb64722
watched runtime changes are exactly tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py, tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.css and tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.js
video experience allowlist is exactly home-market-pulse, capture-quality-gate, purchase-split-view, hot-card-box-ranking and portfolio-summary
experience order is derived from the existing verified 18-feature priorities plus non-directional activity signals only
camera experience reuses existing cameraStatus and glare quality outputs and does not synthesize grading evidence
purchase experience reuses existing purchasePanel, purchaseNearby and purchaseRegionGrid controls and does not invent stock facts
precise current-location coordinates are never persisted by the video experience; only a coarse selected region may be saved locally
HOT ranking uses local verified market_watch, market_prices, releases and promo_events freshness/link/activity evidence and explicitly does not infer market direction
portfolio summary uses current grade state, verified-learning record count and current RAW price text without tracking user click behavior
video-reference DOM and runtime bindings are critical fail-closed UI health checks
experience is user-reversible and restores the original predeclared module order
runtime source generation, arbitrary commands, Git/main writes, verification bypass and price/grade/stock/release/event fact invention remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: The video-reference experience is a predeclared presentation layer over existing verified tablet functions. It may reorder only five allowlisted modules and show verified local evidence, but it cannot generate runtime source code, persist precise location, learn user behavior, infer market direction, invent stock/price/grade/release/event facts, execute arbitrary commands or write Git/main.
